description: Free. The exchange's on-ledger ProvenPayer credential (XLS-70): issued to an XRPL account after 2 settled, Plumb-proven payments to the house; readable by any seller with ledger_entry. Returns the account's standing, the issued credential (with the CredentialCreate hash, provable with plumb-xrpl), how to accept it, and the challenge format for the holder unlock.
name: credential_status
